storage.replaced: settings JSON with typed columns and disabled-tool relation; presets folded into typed configuration directory
storage.run_configuration: immutable settings/model revision references and authority epochs; no config_snapshot JSON
storage.old_v2_development_database: forward-only frozen v5 migration, verified pre-DDL consistent snapshot; unresolved runs are not replayed

capacity.default_counter: utf8-envelope-v1: serialized request UTF-8 byte length plus 256 envelope units
capacity.exact_counter: injected TokenCounter; required matching identity and exact method; no implicit download or paid probe
capacity.input_policy: estimated input + purpose output reservation + margin <= declared context capacity
capacity.summary_policy: whole turns; at most 3 summary calls; separate output cap
capacity.output_overrun: run cannot publish success; known cost remains settled

interfaces.settings: normalized Agent preferences, active model profile and policy revision
interfaces.configurations: typed create/read/CAS save/archive, history, template, passive diagnosis and preview
interfaces.credentials: values are separate from ordinary configuration
interfaces.channel_mcp_runtime: stored metadata only; no connection/OAuth/process startup on save

ui.drafts: at most 64 entries per draft cache, browser-memory only; refresh/close discards unsaved input
ui.remaining: full workbench navigation and very large model catalogue selection remain part of R6
